behavior: Bind new document rows to the exact managed object ID/version and owner_id matching uploaded_by. Recheck claimed uploader student edit access and explicit non-partner status before the narrow privileged storage lookup. Caller RLS and scan guard authenticate uploaded_by separately.
Use transaction-local FOR SHARE metadata lock; do not return a storage row or expose the function as a client/service RPC. The private definer trigger has fixed pg_catalog search path.
Reject absent/malformed version, unavailable owner metadata, missing or foreign path/bucket, mismatched initial claims and later rebinding even by service.
Legacy rows stay unbound without backfilling guessed provenance; ordinary metadata updates remain available. No stored bytes, grants or existing RLS expressions are changed.

sdk_finding.finding: FileObjectV2/info returns ID/version but no reliable managed uploader. FileObject.owner is deprecated and not returned by list/remove. Do not infer ownership from those APIs.
